title: DelegateCapsuleResult
description: Plugin-generated return to Astra's original delegate_capsule call. This is an output envelope, not another tool's parameters.

raw_history.description: Absolute filesystem path to the actual retained UTF-8 JSONL episode transcript. Never transcript text, encoded bytes, a URI, session ID, or placeholder. Runtime code verifies that the file exists and is readable.

report.description: Plugin-authored account of known observations, missing parts, and the runtime failure.
